g.text: Faint edge → large σ → adaptive simplify
AA is not blur — it is area measurement.
Propagates true posterior variance directly to downstream DP curve fitters.

text.tspan: • Blend sliver absorption at AA boundaries
• Fill model selection: Flat / Linear / Radial

g.text: WHY INKVEC DOMINATES PREVIOUS ENGINES (VTRACER, POTRACE, AUTOTRACE)

text.tspan: Conventional: Thresholds pixels to integer raster grid.
Inkvec: Inverts continuous physical coverage mixture,
localizing edges to ~0.02 px with honest uncertainty σ.

g.text: 2. Planar Map DCEL vs Independent Paths

text.tspan: Inkvec: Stores shared edge ONCE in planar subdivision.
Overdraw = 1.000 by invariant; Shewchuk exact predicates.
Conventional: 36 chords or 4 cubics (24 floats) per circle.
Inkvec: MDL DP selects <circle> (3 floats), arcs (5),
or Levien quartic G1 cubics. 3.3× fewer coordinates.
